name: smwgraphics-new-super-mario-bros-desert-inside
title: New Super Mario Bros. - Desert (Inside)
description:
My first successful rip from a spritesheet!! (Sort of...) This is the foreground from World 7-A in New Super Mario Bros. It includes the brown stone blocks and the colored blocks, although you may want to rearrange the palettes a bit.

Credit to Jouw of The Spriters' Resource for the spritesheet.
